title: The Day from Which Storage Runs on a Retrofit Project
content:
# The Day from Which Storage Runs on a Retrofit Project

On a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, the day the storage clock runs from is decided by the delivery day against the day installation was booked to begin, and by whether the owner had asked for the start to be moved.

## The rule

| Circumstance on the project record | The storage clock runs from |
|---|---|
| The equipment arrived before the day installation was booked to begin, and that booked day has already passed | the booked installation day, rather than the arrival day |
| The equipment arrived on or after the booked installation day, and a confirmed schedule request stands on the project record | the day the owner asked for the start to be moved |
| Any other case | the day the equipment arrived |

A lot that arrived ahead of the booked day was not standing at the owner's convenience, which is why the clock on such a lot runs from the booked day and not from the earlier arrival.

The first case requires both things at once: an arrival earlier than the booked day, and a booked day that is already in the past. Where the equipment arrived early but the booked day has not yet come, that case is not met and the clock runs from the day the equipment arrived. The second case reads the confirmed schedule request standing on the project record and takes the day the owner asked for the start to be moved, that is the requested day recorded on the most recent confirmed schedule request.

## Cases (hypothetical dates)

- Equipment arrived on the 4th, installation booked for the 18th, the charge raised on the 30th: the arrival is before the booked day and the booked day has passed, so the clock runs from the 18th.
- Equipment arrived on the 4th, installation booked for the 18th, the charge raised on the 11th: the arrival is before the booked day but that day has not passed, so the clock runs from the 4th.
- Equipment arrived on the 20th, installation booked for the 18th, a confirmed schedule request on the project record recorded on the 9th: the arrival is after the booked day and a confirmed request stands, so the clock runs from the 9th.
- Equipment arrived on the 20th, installation booked for the 18th, no confirmed schedule request on the record: the clock runs from the 20th.
